mechanism: Chlorpromazine is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase bictegravir plasma concentrations, while bictegravir has potential to affect chlorpromazine metabolism through competing pathways.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects (sedation, orthostatic hypotension, extrapyramidal symptoms); consider chlorpromazine dose reduction if toxicity develops; no dose adjustment needed for bictegravir.
